averaging: equal-weight macro across six excerpts, separately per condition
purpose: New amplitude-regularized local waveform agreement experiment after v3 failure. Both prior groups are consumed development data, never qualification.

method.name: candidate_period_local_agreement
method.sampling: numpy linear interpolation at midpoint +/- lag/2; require every position within available waveform samples and real input duration; no zero padding or clamped observations
method.centering: Subtract each arm mean separately in float64
method.statistic: A=mean(a*a), B=mean(b*b), C=mean(a*b); q=clip(2*C/max(A+B,2*min_source_rms**2),-1,1), all accumulated float64; undefined support gives NaN with local_supported=0. Silence/constant full-support arms give0.
method.acceptance: Original v2 framewise gate AND available local evidence AND q>=threshold; no temporal erosion or change to accepted pitch.
method.interpretation: Local repeated waveform energy at candidate period, not voice identity or calibrated probability; periodic instrumental leakage and reverb can pass.
method.reference_scope: Symmetric normalization inspired by NSDF; this candidate-conditioned, mean-centered, amplitude-regularized veto is not the MPM pitch estimator.

prospective_test.selection: First track of each next six unseen singers in numeric ID order, metadata only; no audio, annotations or model output inspected.
prospective_test.prerequisite: Both development groups pass every original gate separately; exact direct/replay agreement, independent review, and immutable candidate/protocol freeze before any test inference.

stop_rule: One frozen local-agreement statistic and four thresholds. If none passes both groups, retain all failures and stop without consuming prospective test. If feasible, freeze exact source and selected threshold then test metadata-selected IDs once; no parameter changes or replacement test after outcomes.
selection: Lowest threshold satisfying all original gates separately in both development groups; disabled-veto control must first reproduce v2 predictions and scores. No threshold-grid expansion or method change after outcomes.
